card.name: Linking words before drug-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "of", "no" and "'s" in sedative or overdose label text, just before a drug-effect noun like "adaptation", "specific antidote" or "specific organ toxicity".

modes.label: Possessive or dosage "of"
modes.description: A linking word after a drug or person name, before a following noun.
